name: xflickr_no_calls_pending

query_condition.sql: SELECT max(CASE WHEN metric='api_calls_10m' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS calls, max(CASE WHEN metric='work_items_pending' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM "xflickr_metrics" WHERE metric IN ('api_calls_10m','work_items_pending') HAVING calls=0 AND pending>0

description: Impact: Pending work is not progressing because no Flickr call is being made. Action: Check scheduler, keys, quota, and worker availability.
